### Steps to reproduce

2. Select the contact that had messages

or

1. close the qToxto the system tray
2. open the qTox

### Observed Behavior

The conversation window does not display old messages after closing it to the system tray or when launching the application closed to the system tray.

### Expected Behavior

Old messages should be displayed

comment_data.body: I've seen this happen even without closing to tray. Sometimes this happens when switching between conversations.

I can reproduce this by just switching to the settings view and then klick on the Contact again -> Messages disappear.
Scroll bar still available and able to scroll - Messages just not being rendered (not even white on white, I can not mark anything in the text window)
Happens to me too.. If i exit (shutdown) Qtox, and restart it, i can get the messages back.  It is annoying.

May have to do with online state of the contact.
If contact is offline -> issue happens, if contact is online -> everything is fine.

Still have to monitor the behavior, maybe someone can confirm or debunk this.

> May have to do with online state of the contact. If contact is offline -> issue happens, if contact is online -> everything is fine.
> 
> Still have to monitor the behavior, maybe someone can confirm or debunk this.

My status was away, i changed my status to online, and i still get a blank page when i click on a user that should have days of messages.

And the users state was? offline or online?
Meanwhile I still think if the contact is offline, at least the bug is more likely to happen (or only happens, if the contact is offline)

Cant recall the issue happening when the contact was online.

I encountered this too, and noticed few things which make it show up again, and this is the easiest if it happened:

### Press ctrl-G (or right-click -> "goto current date").
This reloads the history at the current date, which is the bottom of the history, and makes it show up again. As usual, scrolling up will show older history.

Other things which work but are less easy or less fun:
- Right-click -> "load chat history" (2nd item from the bottom) and click "OK" to load today's history (seems same as ctrl-G, just with two mouse clicks).
- Search the history (ctrl-F or right-click -> "search in text") and type something which is found (one letter is enough).
- Send a message.
- Log out and log in again.

For me the issue seems to happen if I scroll up so that it fetches a bit more history from the disk/database into the window, then scroll back down to the bottom - and then suddenly it fetches the maximum allowed history size from the disk/database (the scrollbar becomes small), and then close and open the window.

If I don't scroll up to fetch more history then the issue doesn't happen to me.

Either way, ctrl-G always seem to make it normal again (and only a small portion of the history is loaded at the window, and the scrollbar is relatively big).

I am also having this issue with a particular person in my chat list...

1. Launch qTox.
2. Open the chat log of said person, everything is normal.
3. Move to another person's chat log.
4. Go back to the first chat log, now all the text disappeared.

This issue is reproducible every time I launch qTox, in both 1.18.3 and nightly.

> This issue is reproducible every time I launch qTox, in both 1.18.3 and nightly.

This is very interesting. We're probably going to release 1.18.4 without a fix for this directly (but a different scrolling bug fix). We'll look into this specific bug of invisible text as the top priority for 1.18.5, which should follow soon after (if we find and fix the bug).

labels.description: Bug fix for the user, not a fix to a build script
